profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg | Real-time Market Data
profile.summary:
Computer Science graduate from the University of Maryland with a deep enthusiasm for technology and a love of learning. 

Currently working with billions of market events daily to characterize and monitor everything about realtime data at Bloomberg.

~ Staying curious & seeking discomfort.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Real-time Market Data
• Building a platform from 0→1 to monitor the correctness and latency of tens of billions of real-time market data events daily across global exchanges.
• Designed and built a high-throughput, real-time ingestion pipeline that lands ~1B market events/day into a data lake for training anomaly detection ML models. (C++ → Kafka → Flink → Iceberg on S3 )

C++23, Python, Big Data, Stream Processing
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Big Data · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Content Creation & Consumption
• Built a Golang pipeline for captioning and translating TikTok videos, processing 10–20 million videos daily.
• Increased global video translation coverage by 6% by detecting and correcting language mismatches using automatic speech recognition.
• Worked with large-scale infrastructure including sharded SQL, Redis, and Grafana for data storage, querying, and pipeline observability.

*(received return offer)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
CMSC132 (Object-Oriented Programming II)
• Led discussion sessions twice a week as the sole instructor for a section of over 30 students.
• Taught and ensured student understanding of Java programming, Object-Oriented programming concepts, data structures, algorithms, debugging and more.
• Hosted office hours for nearly 500 students.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · PySpark · Jenkins · AWS

courses.name: Artifical Intelligence, Machine Learning, Compilers, Cryptography, Advanced Data Structures

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Orchestrated large-scale philanthropic events as the primary organizer, representative, and spokesperson of 90-person chapter.
• Raised over $35,000 annually and managed the largest campus AFSP walk in the tri-state area, 4th largest in country.
